title: Senki Zesshou Symphogear GX: Senki Zesshou Shinai Symphogear
justification: AniList: 4 omake of 8 min, 2015-11-25 to 2016-02-24, title 戦姫絶唱しないシンフォギア. AniDB 10321 S1-S4 are four compilation specials of mini scenes on 2015-11-25, 12-23, 2016-01-27, 02-24. TVDB 254667 season 0 0x3-0x6 "Not-So-Superb Song of the Valkyries: Symphogear GX 1-4" ("Shinai" = "not-so", the AniList title) on the same four dates; the parent's row start=1 end=4 offset=2 already places S1-S4 on them, and 0x1-0x2 are the first season's. Order and four dates agree. No other node claims 0x3-0x6 (11955 takes 0x7-0x11, 11959 0x13-0x16).
